name: norm
description: Build and migrate Bland v2 agents from your coding agent. /norm:build creates NEW v2 agents (with a human-in-the-loop v1-or-v2 gate), /norm:migrate converts v1 pathways/personas with the full hand-migration doctrine, /norm:validate audits snapshots, /norm:simulate verifies with simulations and test chats. Raw-JSON workflow; v2-only — no v1 authoring doctrine, and v1 requests are routed to the v1 plugin.

bland_api_key.title: Bland API key
bland_api_key.description: Your Bland API key from app.bland.ai/settings/api-keys (org that owns the agents). OPTIONAL: leave unset for a keyless install when the project supplies its own Bland connection — commands then verify org identity before any write.

bland_api_url.title: Bland API URL (optional)
bland_api_url.description: Optional. Defaults to production (https://api.bland.ai); only set this to point at a dev/staging server. Not a secret.
